# UpDownScaling {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
UpDownScaling()
```
Chart choice for the δ-chart (up-down scaling) by Bandt (2019), Equation (6). For pattern length `m = 3`, the statistic is $\hat{\delta} = \hat{p}_2 + \hat{p}_3 - \hat{p}_4 - \hat{p}_5$.
 


:::
